accepted.label: Expected Value of Sample Information (EVSI)
accepted.description: The difference between the expected monetary value with free sample information and without that information, representing the maximum a decision maker should pay for the sample.
coverage_criteria: Compute EVSI from a decision tree with sample information.
Interpret EVSI as a threshold for purchasing information.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone concept: EVSI measures value of sample information and is distinct from EVPI in math and application.

accepted.label: Expected Value of Perfect Information (EVPI)
accepted.description: The difference between the expected monetary value with free perfect information and without information, serving as the upper bound on the value of any imperfect sample information.
coverage_criteria: Compute EVPI from a simple decision scenario.
Explain why EVPI is the upper limit for EVSI.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone concept: EVPI measures value of perfect information and is distinct from EVSI in math and reference point.
